notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
-Fixed bug where shovel would add game objects to inventory
-Fixed bug where using items with coconut would destroy them
-Removed "graphics update" heading

notes.title: The Graphics Update!
notes.content:
The graphics for Lost Awakening have been updated to have a clean and crisp retro feel! Don't worry though: if you prefer the original graphics, you can change them back to the old graphics in the options menu. 

This patch includes:
[list]
[*] Completely updated graphics.
[*] Fixed a bug where click to use items with the shovel would cause the items to disappear.
[*] WAY more Persian rugs.
[/list]
